desc: Ship is an ethereal copy entangled to its parent vessel, and leaves a trail of energy connecting the two. Additionally, flux vent rate increases by %s when above %s flux, at the expense of generating %s to the parent ship.

name: Linear Phase Coils
desc:
Ship is equipped with an experimental Linear Phase Coil. In general, ships with Linear Phase Coils make more shallow dives into p-space than traditional phase coils, boosting their speed, but are less efficient.

The max phased speed reduction is %s at %s hard flux, and the time flow boost is %s normal time.

Additionally, their inefficient nature means the coils cannot be run for extended periods of time. However, emissions are reduced and the ships sensor profile is lowered by %s.

name: Exacting Specifications
desc: The ship systems have been tightly constructed to maximize its design performance. However, the delicate balance means core components can not be safely modified.

name: Stressed Command Net
desc: Controlling large numbers of craft requires an extensive command net, which slows the speed that orders are passed down the chain. Reduces the command point recovery rate by %s when ship is deployed.
short: Reduces the command point recovery rate.

name: Prototype Hull
desc: Ships hull design has not been finalized and lacks certain optimizations. Weapons and engines are more likely to %s when combat readiness is stressed, and weapons have %s less health.
short: Weapon and engines more likely to malfunction.

name: Advanced Point Defense AI
desc: Gives all point-defense weapons the ability to identify - and ignore - decoy flares. In addition, all point-defense weapons get the best possible target leading, regardless of combat readiness, and all damage to missiles is increased by %s. All small non-missile, non-strike weapons are classified as "point-defense", automatically target missiles, are affected by point-defense stat modifiers, and beam weapons turn %s faster.
short: PD ignores decoy flares, improved target leading, more damage to missiles, all small weapons target missiles.

name: Stealth Plating
short: Reduces ship sensor profile, but slightly increases beam damage taken.

name: Exposed Flight Deck
desc:
A large portion of the ships flight deck is exposed to space, increasing risk of crew casualties by %s if %s is occupied.

Further more, should the ship suffer damage, the maximum fighter replacement rate will decrease according to the damage sustained, bottoming out at %s when almost destroyed.
short: Increases crew lost to damage as well as fighter readiness.
